def parse_point(text):
    """Parse a point written as "(x, y)", where x and y are integers that may be negative,
    with optional spaces. Return the tuple (x, y) of ints, and raise ValueError when the
    text is not of that form.
    """
    match = re.fullmatch(r"\s*\(\s*(-?\d+)\s*,\s*(-?\d+)\s*\)\s*", text)

    return int(match.group(1)), int(match.group(2))
"}

def word_counts(text):
    """Count the words in text.

    A word is a run of the letters a to z, compared without regard to case, so "Cat" and
    "cat" are the same word; digits and punctuation separate words. Return a dict that maps
    each word, in lower case, to the number of times it occurs.
